title: MV Yanfly Message Backlog Plugin Not Working [SOLVED]

posts.author: YoctoCrunch
posts.body:
Hellooo, I'm trying to use Yanfly's Message Backlog Plugin but I can't seem to get it to work at all!
The default button to bring up the message backlog is Shift but when clicked, it doesn't bring up anything. I switched the button to Tab yet, the message backlog still won't pop up. Besides changing the backlog key button, everything else has remained as default in the plugin options.
I only have 4 plugins installed in this test project: YEP Core Engine, YEP Message Core, YEP Message Backlog, and GALV Message Busts. The plugins are arranged in that order.
I've looked all over the internet for a solution and found that
this person has a similar issue
but it was never resolved.
Any idea what I'm doing wrong? OTL

posts.author: Xaniro
posts.body: What engine are you using? If it is mz, those plugins will not work since the yanfly plugins are for mv

posts.author: PhantomPixel
posts.body:
Hi! So I'm not entirely familiar with YEP's plugins (I use MZ), but from what I found in
this
thread, it sounds like the "Backlog Key Button" is only intended to open the backlog while dialogue is being presented, and not just anywhere on the map. So if that's the effect you're going for, check the replies in the thread I linked.
